stylePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production UI icon for Lumin, a refined dental clinic app. Render a fresh minimal 3D clay/porcelain icon, designed to remain clear at 28-32 CSS pixels. Centered isolated object, orthographic three-quarter front view, compact bold silhouette, soft satin ceramic materials, white porcelain plus one restrained pastel accent, gentle light from upper left, subtle object self-shadow. Real transparent alpha background. Object fills approximately 82% of the square canvas with clean transparent padding. Maximum two simple visual elements. No floor, base, badge, circle, tile, backdrop, cast shadow outside object, lettering, numbers, watermarks, outlines, tiny tools, or fine decorative details.

icons.subject: General dentistry: one friendly anatomical white porcelain molar with a very pale dental-blue shaded side; two short distinct roots, simple rounded crown. Only the tooth.
Diagnosis: one white porcelain molar and one small thick navy-blue magnifying glass overlapping its lower right. Two objects only.
Preventive dentistry: one white porcelain molar with one small solid pastel-mint shield overlapping its lower right. No symbols or extra objects.
Restorative dentistry: a single white porcelain molar viewed slightly from above, with one clearly visible turquoise-blue inlay filling on its chewing surface. Tooth plus filling, no instruments.
Endodontics: one white porcelain molar in a simplified cutaway view with one bold coral-red root-canal path visible inside the two roots. Single tooth cutaway; no tools.
Crowns: one elegant simple tooth-shaped ceramic crown cap with a warm pale-gold exterior and a subtle white porcelain lower rim. A single crown, no tooth underneath and no royal crown.
Prosthodontics: a compact two-unit porcelain dental bridge, two adjacent simple white tooth crowns joined by a short pale-blue connector. Two crowns only; no roots, tools, or gum.
Implant dentistry: a simple white porcelain tooth crown seated on a short titanium-silver threaded dental implant screw. Crown and screw only; thick readable threads.
Periodontics: one clean white porcelain molar seated in one small soft coral-pink curved gum segment. Tooth and gum only, no bone or instruments.
Cosmetic dentistry: one beautifully smooth white porcelain front incisor and one small solid lavender four-point sparkle near its upper right. Two elements only.
Oral surgery: one white porcelain tooth beside one compact silver dental extraction forceps with soft steel-blue handles. Two clear simple objects, chunky shapes, no blood.

Orthodontics: one white porcelain front incisor with one simple silver-blue orthodontic bracket centered on its face. Tooth and bracket only; a short thick blue horizontal wire integrated into the bracket.

Paediatric dentistry: the same white porcelain two-root molar as the general-dentistry icon, with a small friendly baby's head beside its lower right. The tooth remains the main object; the baby's round warm-beige face, tiny brown hair curl, two simple dark eyes and subtle smile form one compact secondary object. Tooth plus baby head only, no body, neck, clothing, star, props or extra symbols.
icons.promptOverride: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the replacement production paediatric-dentistry icon for Lumin. Reference 1 is the tooth from the existing newly generated icon set: keep this exact visual family, molar shape, white porcelain material, pale dental-blue side shading, orthographic three-quarter view and soft upper-left lighting. Reference 2 supplies the friendly clay-rendered head style, but simplify it into a baby with a round face and one tiny brown hair curl. Paediatric dentistry: the same white porcelain two-root molar as the general-dentistry icon, with a small friendly baby's head beside its lower right. The tooth remains the main object; the baby's round warm-beige face, tiny brown hair curl, two simple dark eyes and subtle smile form one compact secondary object. Tooth plus baby head only, no body, neck, clothing, star, props or extra symbols. Arrange both side by side as one compact icon, with the tooth on the left taking approximately 60% of the combined width and the baby head on the right taking 40%, aligned slightly lower; a very small overlap is acceptable but keep the entire face and the two tooth roots visible. Both must remain unmistakable when the finished square is exported to 64px and displayed at 32px. Center the combined silhouette, filling about 86% of the square. Soft satin 3D porcelain/clay, minimal details, transparent alpha background. No floor, cast shadow outside the objects, base, badge, circle, tile, text, outlines or decorative elements. Exactly two objects: a tooth and a baby's head.

icons.subject: Dental imaging: one small translucent deep-blue radiograph plate containing a single bright white simplified tooth silhouette. A single rectangular plate with softly rounded corners; no frame, lettering or plus symbols.
Oral medicine: one small white porcelain molar beside one simple mint-and-white medicine capsule. Tooth and capsule only, clearly separated silhouettes.
